description: August birthdays: zodiac signs and decans for every day of August, cusp dates, the month's numerology and its Chinese zodiac boundary.
answer: In Western astrology, August birthdays fall under Leo and Virgo. In most years August birthdays from the 1st to the 22nd are Leo, and from the 23rd they are Virgo. August 22, August 23 and August 24 are cusp dates. In numerology August is month 8.

sections.heading: Zodiac signs and decans in August
paragraphs: August opens in the first decan of Leo, where the Sun's double rulership makes the Lion at its warmest. Around August 3 the second decan begins, and Jupiter adds humour, generosity and a taste for grand plans. From about August 13, the third decan places Mars as sub-ruler, giving the sign a more forceful, competitive edge. Around August 22 or 23 the Sun moves into Virgo, from fixed fire to mutable earth, and the mood shifts from performance to preparation. Virgo's first decan, with Mercury doubled, is the most analytical part of an analytical sign. August birthdays therefore cover a wide range, from expansive showmanship to careful precision, and people born at the boundary often combine a wish to shine with a wish to get every detail right.

In most years August birthdays from the 1st to the 22nd are Leo, and from the 23rd they are Virgo. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are August 22, 23 and 24; each has its own page explaining both possibilities. Decan by decan, the month opens in the first decan of Leo, linked with Sun, from the 3rd the second decan of Leo, linked with Jupiter, from the 13th the third decan of Leo, linked with Mars and from the 23rd the first decan of Virgo, linked with Mercury.

sections.heading: August birthdays in numerology and the Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: Numerologically, August is month 8, the number of ambition, management and practical power. It tends to add drive and an interest in tangible results to a birth date, which sits naturally with Leo's leadership and Virgo's competence. August birthdays follow the Chinese animal of the calendar year. For the Four Pillars month, the Monkey takes over around August 7 or 8 with the Beginning of Autumn, a solar term that arrives while the northern summer is still in full swing. Most August birthdays therefore carry the Monkey in the month pillar, an animal traditionally associated with cleverness, adaptability and playful problem-solving. Together with the executive 8, it gives the month a quick, resourceful flavour that suits people who like to win by thinking several moves ahead.
Every page for an August date lists the Life Path for several birth years, because the year changes the total even when the day stays the same.

sections.heading: Famous August birthdays
paragraphs: Each August page lists the best-known people born on that date, drawn from Wikidata and ranked by how many Wikipedia language editions have an article about them. A sample across the month: Herman Melville (August 1), Barack Obama (August 4), Charlize Theron (August 7), Herbert Hoover (August 10), Fidel Castro (August 13), Madonna (August 16), Bill Clinton (August 19), Deng Xiaoping (August 22), Sean Connery (August 25), José Eduardo dos Santos (August 28) and Tsai Ing-wen (August 31). Sharing a birthday with someone well known says nothing about a life's direction, but it is a pleasant way into the date's sign, decan and numbers, which each page then explains in turn. The lists favour people with a precisely recorded birth date in the modern Gregorian calendar, so some much-celebrated figures from earlier centuries are missing.

faq.question: What zodiac signs are August birthdays?
faq.answer: In most years August birthdays from the 1st to the 22nd are Leo, and from the 23rd they are Virgo. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are August 22, 23 and 24; each has its own page explaining both possibilities.

faq.question: What is the numerology number of August?
faq.answer: August is month 8. The month is one of three parts of the Life Path calculation, with the day and the year.

faq.question: Which Chinese zodiac animal is someone born in August?
faq.answer: Lunar New Year has always passed by August, so an August birth takes the animal of the calendar birth year.
